scoring_justification: Recomputing DFT properties from raw outputs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; we compare the agent's reported CSV values against the paper's Table 1 with tolerances and additionally verify the convex-hull stability condition from the submitted formation energies.

outputs.description: Table of computed formation energies, relaxed lattice constants, and bulk moduli for all Mg-Pd intermetallic phases and pure elements. The checker compares each value against the paper-reported reference values with appropriate tolerances and also verifies that all formation energies lie on the convex hull at 0 K.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will additionally perform a structural audit: it computes the convex hull from the Pd mole fraction and formation energies, and verifies that no reported point lies above the hull.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for formation energies, lattice constants, bulk moduli from Table 1 of the paper, used for tolerance-based scoring and convex hull check.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1, 'This work' column. Values are the paper's own computed results.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from Table 1 of the paper (Insight into Phase Stability in the Mg-Pd System... J. Phase Equilib. Diffus. 2020). No fabrication.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are publicly reported in the paper and serve as the hidden gold for comparison; they represent the exact target of reproduction.

steps.description: Compare formation energy, lattice constants, and bulk modulus for each phase against paper reference with tolerances. Formation energy tolerance: 0.1 eV/atom with directional threshold (lower is better). Lattice constant tolerance: 2% relative. Bulk modulus tolerance: 10% relative.
Verify that all formation energies lie on the convex hull at 0 K within tolerance.
